subject: Draft MAP: SDK streaming + tool-calls delivery schedule & owner commitments
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Alex Palmer <alex.p@carewell.com>
Cc: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@carewell.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP: SDK streaming + tool-calls delivery schedule & owner commitments

Hi Alex / Sophie —

Thanks again for the call today. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan section focused on the SDK integration milestone (v0.3). High-level recap and asks:

- Goal: Deliver streaming + tool-calls + structured-output support in the CareWell integration so ShadowProd can go live with embedded summaries and automated order-routing.
- Target close date (contract): 2026-04-30 (customer requested end-of-April). MAP milestone target for SDK delivery: 2026-04-08 (to allow 3 weeks of integration + 1 week of canary).
- Dependencies: access to staging dataset (~2M events), service account for KV cache tests, DocuSign signed SOW (pending), and CareWell rate-limits for streaming test harness.

I attached the MAP_v0.3 workbook with milestones, tentative owners, and a short sequencing diagram. Please confirm the timeline and any missing dependencies.

Immediate asks:
1) Alex — confirm you can provision the staging dataset and grant the service account by 2026-02-26.
2) Sophie — confirm internal QA lead and testing window (ideally 2026-04-09 to 2026-04-23).
3) Redwood team — review owners column and flag bandwidth blockers by EOD Friday.

I'll follow up with an internal owners assignment shortly.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

Attachments: MAP_v0.3_CareWell_SDK_build_plan.xlsx (workbook), sdk_streaming_sequence.drawio.png (diagram)

From: Alex Palmer <alex.p@carewell.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@carewell.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: SDK streaming + tool-calls delivery schedule & owner commitments

Thanks Aditya — appreciate the clear notes.

Quick answers from our side:
- Staging dataset: we can provision a masked subset by 2026-02-25 and add the service account. I’ll send the access ticket once it’s created.
- QA lead: I’m looping in Jasmin (internal) but Sophie will confirm the test window. Tentatively we can do the functional pass 2026-04-10 to 2026-04-16 and a regression/cutover test 2026-04-20 to 2026-04-23.
- DocuSign SOW: procurement needs one more pricing line clarified; expect signature week of 2026-03-01.

One ask: can Redwood provide a small test harness that emits token-level latency logs for streaming (to validate batching behavior)? If yes, include as dependency in MAP.

Alex

--
Alex Palmer
Director, Integrations | CareWell Health
alex.p@carewell.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Draft MAP: SDK streaming + tool-calls delivery schedule & owner commitments

Team — forwarding Alex's answers and the attached MAP v0.3. Summary of what we need from Redwood and proposed owners (please reply inline with adjustments):

- Provision test harness (latency emitter + token logs) — Proposed owner: Priyom Das (Engineering Solutions)
- SDK streaming implementation and tool-call glue (including structured-output JSON schema) — Proposed owner: Kimberly Park (SDK lead)
- Integration test matrix and canary plan — Proposed owner: Neha Kapoor (Customer Success)
- KV cache and sequence length tuning (runtime infra) — Support from Runtime team (TBD)
- Docs & example app for CareWell engineering — Proposed owner: Aditya Rao (AE) / Kimberly to produce samples.

Risks and blockers:
- Procurement SOW timing may push the contract close beyond target.
- Staging data provisioning must include representative conversation lengths (we need some >4k token sequences for stress tests).

Action items (small):
- Priyom: scope the latency emitter by 2026-02-24 and attach a simple README/test script.
- Kimberly: review SDK changes and provide an ETA for a dev-preview by 2026-03-20.
- Neha: own the canary window coordination with CareWell and run an acceptance checklist.

Please use the MAP workbook to edit owners cells directly (I’ve granted edit access to the team). If we can agree on owners by Friday, I’ll send an updated MAP to CareWell and lock milestones.

Thanks,
Aditya

Attachments referenced: MAP_v0.3_CareWell_SDK_build_plan.xlsx, test_matrix.csv

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: SDK streaming + tool-calls delivery schedule & owner commitments

All — quick status. I’ll take the latency emitter and produce a minimal harness that streams synthetic messages and emits per-token latency to a CSV. Plan:
- Proto harness (node script) by 2026-02-24
- Add token-logging and basic aggregation by 2026-03-03
- Publish README + example flags for streaming batch sizes and simulated network jitter.

Kimberly — do you want me to include a mock for tool-calls (HTTP stub) so SDK can exercise structured outputs end-to-end? That would make the canary much more realistic.

I’ll update the MAP owners column to mark this as assigned and link the test repo once I create it.

- Priyom
Engineering Solutions | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
